name: Naphthylaminopropane
summary: Naphthylaminopropane (NAP; code name PAL-287), also known as naphthylisopropylamine (NIPA), is an experimental drug of the amphetamine and naphthylaminopropane families that was under investigation for the treatment of alcohol and stimulant addiction.

pharmacology.text: Naphthylaminopropane is a serotonin–norepinephrine–dopamine releasing agent (SNDRA). Its EC50 values for induction of monoamine release are 3.4 nM for serotonin, 11.1 nM for norepinephrine, and 12.6 nM for dopamine. The drug is also an agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2A, 5-HT2B, and 5-HT2C receptors. Its EC50 values are 466 nM at the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor, 40 nM at the serotonin 5-HT2B receptor, and 2.3 nM at the serotonin 5-HT2C receptor.

summaryZh: 2-萘基異丙胺，分子式C13H15N，用作興奮劑和酒精成癮的試驗藥物。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. It releases serotonin as well as dopamine and noradrenaline, and drugs that do this can cause nausea, raised blood pressure and, at high exposure, serotonin syndrome.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它會同時釋放血清素、多巴胺與正腎上腺素，這類藥物可能引起噁心、血壓上升，暴露量高時還可能造成血清素症候群。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它会同时释放血清素、多巴胺与正肾上腺素，这类药物可能引起恶心、血压上升，暴露量高时还可能造成血清素症候群。

fact.en: Its code name PAL-287 comes from the Pharmacology and Antiaddiction Laboratory where it was made. It replaces amphetamine's single benzene ring with the double ring of naphthalene, the chemical in mothballs.
fact.zh: 它的代號 PAL-287 來自研發它的藥理與戒癮實驗室。它把安非他命的單一苯環換成萘的雙環結構，萘正是樟腦丸的主要成分。
fact.zhHans: 它的代号 PAL-287 来自研发它的药理与戒瘾实验室。它把安非他命的单一苯环换成萘的双环结构，萘正是樟脑丸的主要成分。
